name: Creator Black Friday
accepts: Deals that help creators. Groups: For Creators, Utilities, AI, For Developers, For Business. Mac utilities, an app for Mac and iPhone, and deals without a code are listed.
how_to_submit: The 'Add a Deal' link on the page opens an Airtable form.
entry_format: Fields: email, product name, subheading (for example '50% OFF LIFETIME DEAL'), a 10 to 20 word description, product type, product category, product URL, square https image URL.
rules: Reviewed by hand for theme fit. First come, first listed. Some listings may not be accepted.
A 2 Nov 2026 check called this site dead; that was wrong. It runs a 2026 edition.
status_note: 114 deals on 22 Nov 2026 (79 on 20 Nov), with an 'Add a Deal' form. The page calls itself 'A curated list' and does not show which deals came through the form, so no outside submission could be confirmed.
